_readme: Posts are sent by scripts/x-post.mjs from a GitHub Actions job. A post goes out only when approved is true. Times are UTC: slot A 03:35, B 09:05, C 15:35, counted from startDate (day 1; day 0 is the day before). Set paused to true to stop everything.
